Subject: Nectar Systems — Onboarding checklist: insurance evidence, PO timing and billing

Hi Sara,

Welcome — glad to get Nectar Systems set up. To move vendor setup and PO issuance along we need three items to complete our procurement checklist:

1) Certificate(s) of Insurance (COI) showing General Liability (GL) and Workers' Comp;
2) E&O / Cyber liability evidence or endorsement;
3) Completed W-9 (or equivalent tax form) and billing contact + remit instructions.

Can you drop the COIs and W-9 into the Drive folder linked below, or attach to a reply? Also helpful: insurer name, policy numbers, aggregate limits, and expiration dates. For PO timing: finance typically issues a PO once COI + W9 are validated — turnaround is ~2 business days after receipt.

Quick asks:
- Send COI PDFs that include Redwood Inference as certificate holder (Recipient: Redwood Inference, 100 Market St, San Francisco, CA).
- Confirm whether Nectar requires Net-30, Net-45 or has other payment terms.
- Provide the billing email and preferred invoice format (PDF, e-invoice).

I'm looping in Laura (legal) and Rachel (account manager) to help with any contract redlines or product questions. Let me know if you'd prefer a short call tomorrow to walk through the checklist.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNectarOnboardingDocs
Procurement request: https://app.redwood.com/procurement/requests/OPP-2026-0743

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
